from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialSnapshot(BaseModel):
    """
    Represents the financial data extracted from a single company's 2025 Q1 report.
    Fields are kept as str or float to allow the downstream inference agent to 
    compute the Debt-to-Asset Ratio and compare against the threshold.
    """
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The legal name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock ticker code if provided in the document")
    total_assets: Optional[float] = Field(description="Total Assets value in original currency")
    equity_attributable: Optional[float] = Field(description="Equity Attributable to Shareholders value in original currency")
    reporting_date: Optional[str] = Field(description="Date string indicating the reporting period end, e.g. '2025-03-31'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """
    Aggregates all CompanyFinancialSnapshot instances from the document collection.
    The list allows the inference agent to iterate and filter all companies.
    """
    company_snapshots: List[CompanyFinancialSnapshot]
